full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad featuring a male baritone vocalist. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A clean electric guitar provides subtle arpeggiated textures in the background. The vocal performance is intimate with breathy delivery in the lower register, transitioning to more resonant tones. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The production uses a hall reverb on the vocals and piano to create a spacious acoustic environment. The bass is absent in this section, focusing on the interplay between the piano and the vocal melody.
